unit_or_scale: unitless area under the receiver operating characteristic curve
single_molecule_interpretation: classification score/probability can be visualized for an individual molecule, but AUROC is a task-level ranking metric

unit_or_scale: unitless area under the precision-recall curve
single_molecule_interpretation: classification score/probability can be visualized for an individual molecule, but AUPRC is a task-level ranking metric

unit_or_scale: same transformed label scale used by the corresponding TDC endpoint
single_molecule_interpretation: absolute prediction error is meaningful on the endpoint's reported label scale
single molecules do not define a Spearman score; molecule-level continuous values are visualization only

unit_or_scale: TDC AqSolDB solubility label scale, conventionally reported as log mol/L
single_molecule_interpretation: absolute error is in the transformed solubility scale

unit_or_scale: percent plasma protein binding on the TDC PPBR label scale
single_molecule_interpretation: absolute error is approximately percentage-point error on the reported label scale

unit_or_scale: TDC clearance label scale; official metric is rank correlation
single_molecule_interpretation: single-molecule values are qualitative continuous-score examples, not single-molecule Spearman errors
